Michelle (CS): Heads up — Pelago kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: roles, success criteria, 30/60/90, enablement plan. Can everyone drop their stakeholder names? cc @Diego
Diego (AE): I'll invite Pelago: Ava (product), Mark (infra), Lin (security). Bringing legal later. FYI renewal touchpoint in Q3 — flagged as medium risk.
Priya (Solutions): Thanks — can we get current integration state? I need access to their sandbox. @Ava can you share API keys or reproduce steps?
Ava (Customer): Hi all! Yes — sandbox creds in shared drive: https://drive.redwood/pelago/onboard. API keys rotated weekly; I'll create a long-lived demo key for this kickoff.
Samir (Eng): We'll want to validate model selection and dedicated capacity estimate. Quick ask: typical concurrency and max seq length? @Ava
Ava (Customer): Expected concurrency 30 rps burst, avg 5. Max seq 2048 tokens. We'll start w/ hosted, may move to Dedicated in Q2.
Michelle (CS): Success criteria proposals: 1) 90% of calls < 250ms p50; 2) end-to-end feature in staging by day 14; 3) enablement playbook + runbook by day 30. Thoughts?
Priya (Solutions): Agree. Add training session for their SREs and support runbook + on-call contact. I'll schedule enablement week-of 2/5.
Diego (AE): Noted renewal risk: Pelago handles PHI in some flows. Need Private deployment checklist and SOC2 addendum. @Michelle can you surface to legal?
Michelle (CS): On it. Filing a privacy/contract ask. Filing ticket: #legal-requests-9876.
OnboardBot: Reminder: kickoff meeting scheduled in 24h. Dial-in: meet.redwood.com/rooms/342
Samir (Eng): Prep items for eng: sample payloads, expected traffic pattern, sample prompt set. I'll draft the perf test script: ```bash ./perf_test.sh --rps 30 --seq 2048```
Ava (Customer): :thumbsup: I'll upload sample payloads by EOD.
Michelle (CS): Great. I'll capture notes and action owners. Quick owners: Diego (sales/contract), Priya (enablement), Samir (eng), Michelle (CS). Looping legal and infra. Anything else?
Priya (Solutions): Can we lock the 30/60/90 milestones? Day 1 kickoff, Day 14 staging signoff, Day 30 go-live readiness check. I'll add to calendar invite.
